entries.title: Narrator: "My royal yacht, the Rizania, smooth..."
entries.dialogueText: My royal yacht, the Rizania, smoothly cleaved through the waters of the Zpana river delta.

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""What a great idea this boat tour w..."
entries.dialogueText: "What a great idea this boat tour was. It would have been a pity to spend our entire visit trapped in a stuffy old palace."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I stood on the deck next to Ewald A..."
entries.dialogueText: I stood on the deck next to Ewald Alphonso, President of Sordland.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The ship's horn let out a blast as..."
entries.dialogueText: The ship's horn let out a blast as we passed beneath the bridge.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I directed the Sordish president's..."
entries.dialogueText: I directed the Sordish president's attention to the glass skyscrapers of the New Town, where Rizia's banks and major corporations were headquartered.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I led the Sordish president to the..."
entries.dialogueText: I led the Sordish president to the southern side of the deck for a better view of the Old Town. The late afternoon sun perfectly illuminated the spire of the Zilba Archsanctuary.

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""See, this is what I like about you..."
entries.dialogueText: "See, this is what I like about your country. You're not afraid of the future."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Terrific, the way you've preserved..."
entries.dialogueText: "Terrific, the way you've preserved these historic buildings. But sometimes the past can be a trap."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Trust me, I know. I've got hundred..."
entries.dialogueText: "Trust me, I know. I've got hundreds of years of history weighing on me every day."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If my grandmother hadn't made thos..."
entries.dialogueText: "If my grandmother hadn't made those trade deals between Rizia and Sordland, our countries would still be strangers."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm happy your country finally has..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm happy your country finally has a president who understands that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm not one to look backwards. Nei..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not one to look backwards. Neither are you, I hear."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't let the razzle-dazzle fool y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't let the razzle-dazzle fool you. Rizia is as stuck in the past as it ever was."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Those skyscrapers are an eyesore.""
entries.dialogueText: "Those skyscrapers are an eyesore."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel smoothly appeared from behind..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel smoothly appeared from behind us with three glasses. Gus handed him the bottle.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We raised our glasses."
entries.dialogueText: We raised our glasses.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I took a sip without bothering to t..."
entries.dialogueText: I took a sip without bothering to toast. The two others gave me a puzzled look, then shrugged.

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""To hell with tradition, right?""
entries.dialogueText: "To hell with tradition, right?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A Morgna wes core!""
entries.dialogueText: "A Morgna wes core!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The two Sordish men smiled politely..."
entries.dialogueText: The two Sordish men smiled politely.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To new beginnings.""
entries.dialogueText: "To new beginnings."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""And new prosperity.""
entries.dialogueText: "And new prosperity."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To our ancestors.""
entries.dialogueText: "To our ancestors."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""May they rest in peace.""
entries.dialogueText: "May they rest in peace."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Ah, yes. The free trade of Rizian..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, yes. The free trade of Rizian wine for Sordish whiskey. As good a way as any to get our relations flowing again, if you'll pardon the pun."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That can't be the only reason you'..."
entries.dialogueText: "That can't be the only reason you've traveled all this way."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sordish whiskey? I'd have to taste..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordish whiskey? I'd have to taste it first."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""I was saving this until after dinn..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was saving this until after dinner, but here you go."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He opened his attache and pulled ou..."
entries.dialogueText: He opened his attache and pulled out a bottle of Erlory Maroon 30-Year-Old.

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""I'll do the toast this time. How d..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll do the toast this time. How do you people say it? A proso!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We drank. The flavor rushed over my..."
entries.dialogueText: We drank. The flavor rushed over my tongue -- wood smoke and forest moss tapering off to a sweet, silky smooth finish.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's heavenly.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's heavenly."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Disgusting. Why would anyone want..."
entries.dialogueText: "Disgusting. Why would anyone want a drink that tastes like trees?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's great, but I'd better not hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's great, but I'd better not have any more."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""And they say royals have sophistic..."
entries.dialogueText: "And they say royals have sophisticated palates. Your countrymen will go crazy for this."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""Like tasting the very soul of Erlo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Like tasting the very soul of Erlory itself."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""That's liquid gold you're leaving..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's liquid gold you're leaving in your glass."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""So, is it a trade, Your Majesty?""
entries.dialogueText: "So, is it a trade, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Definitely. Expect to see all our..."
entries.dialogueText: "Definitely. Expect to see all our bars serving Sordish whiskey by next year."
entries.menuText: "Definitely. Expect to see all our bars serving Sordish whiskey by next year." [Trade Deal]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. Our wine is so superior to you..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. Our wine is so superior to your whiskey that it wouldn't be fair to us."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Excellent, Your Majesty. Another r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Excellent, Your Majesty. Another reason for me to return to this gem of a country."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""But the opportunity they represent..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the opportunity they represent? Beautiful."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""You and I are meeting, aren't we?..."
entries.dialogueText: "You and I are meeting, aren't we? That's already progress."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""I owe a lot to Colonel Soll. But i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I owe a lot to Colonel Soll. But it's high time Sordland moved on."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My grandmother was definitely thin..."
entries.dialogueText: "My grandmother was definitely thinking ahead when she made those trade deals with Sordland years ago."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Lyza the Great. It's not easy, liv..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lyza the Great. It's not easy, living in the shadows of our predecessors."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""But if my forward-thinking develop..."
entries.dialogueText: "But if my forward-thinking development minister hadn't reconnected us, we'd still be estranged."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Light as a feather compared to the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Light as a feather compared to the legacy of one Colonel Soll."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gus Manger emerged from the ship's..."
entries.dialogueText: Gus Manger emerged from the ship's cabin, clutching a bottle and grinning triumphantly.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""Ewald! They have it!""
entries.dialogueText: "Ewald! They have it!"

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""I tried Cantuavo exactly once, fro..."
entries.dialogueText: "I tried Cantuavo exactly once, from a Rizian chef in Holsord who smuggled it over in his steamer trunk. Haven't stopped thinking about it ever since."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned to me apologetically."
entries.dialogueText: He turned to me apologetically.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""Our mutual friend Russello mention..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our mutual friend Russello mentioned your yacht had an excellent wine cellar, and, well, I couldn't help myself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mr. Montoro is not my friend. And..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Montoro is not my friend. And I'd appreciate it if you didn't go rooting around in my ship's quarters."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you're that impressed by a Cant..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you're that impressed by a Cantuavo, I hate to think of the swill they must be serving in Sordland."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A man of exquisite taste. I like y..."
entries.dialogueText: "A man of exquisite taste. I like you already."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gus laughed delightedly."
entries.dialogueText: Gus laughed delightedly.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""You hear that, Ewald! Swill! Giral..."
entries.dialogueText: "You hear that, Ewald! Swill! Giralt of Ribery must be spinning in his grave. Butler!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rusty has certainly sampled enough..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rusty has certainly sampled enough wine to know what he's talking about."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""Forgive me, Your Majesty. But we c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forgive me, Your Majesty. But we can't let this beautiful bottle go to waste now that it's been exposed to sunlight, can we? Butler!"

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""I wouldn't mind gaining some first..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't mind gaining some firsthand knowledge myself. Butler!"

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""A toast to exquisite taste, then...."
entries.dialogueText: "A toast to exquisite taste, then. Butler!"

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Excellent choice, Mr. Manger. Plea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Excellent choice, Mr. Manger. Please allow me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned his back as he filled our..."
entries.dialogueText: He turned his back as he filled our glasses, secretly pouring a nonalcoholic wine substitute into mine. We were used to this routine by now.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""And stay buried.""
entries.dialogueText: "And stay buried."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""And new friends.""
entries.dialogueText: "And new friends."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""We don't usually toast with that p..."
entries.dialogueText: "We don't usually toast with that phrase. But nice pronunciation."

entries.dialogueText: "Yes, well done. Vectern sis da."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""Right!""
entries.dialogueText: "Right!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We drank. Gus sighed with pure plea..."
entries.dialogueText: We drank. Gus sighed with pure pleasure. Alphonso's expression bordered on disbelief.

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""All apologies to Giralt of Ribery,..."
entries.dialogueText: "All apologies to Giralt of Ribery, but this is in fact the best wine I've ever tasted."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""I told you! I know certain Sordish..."
entries.dialogueText: "I told you! I know certain Sordish movers and shakers who'd kill to have access to a beverage of this caliber."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""Which brings me to that deal I sug..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which brings me to that deal I suggested..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Rizians do not drink whiskey, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""Our turn to be the connoisseurs, Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our turn to be the connoisseurs, Your Majesty. Butler! Three tumblers, no ice."

entries.dialogueText: Pabel approached with three glasses.

entries.dialogueText: "Just a small sip for me. To make sure my people aren't getting an inferior product."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Actually, I'll take your word for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Actually, I'll take your word for it. The wine's already gone to my head."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If I didn't know any better, I'd s..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I didn't know any better, I'd say you two were trying to get me drunk."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""I really must insist.""
entries.dialogueText: "I really must insist."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""One does not get merely 'drunk' on..."
entries.dialogueText: "One does not get merely 'drunk' on Erlory Maroon 30-Year-Old. One floats."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope this is as good as you say.""
entries.dialogueText: "I hope this is as good as you say."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""That's because they've never tried..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's because they've never tried this."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""Call it an aperitif.""
entries.dialogueText: "Call it an aperitif."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alphonso opened his attache and pul..."
entries.dialogueText: Alphonso opened his attache and pulled out a bottle of Erlory Maroon 30-Year-Old.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""It's even better.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's even better."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The yacht lingered at the mouth of..."
entries.dialogueText: The yacht lingered at the mouth of the Zpana delta as the sun lowered in the sky, turning the water from turquoise to gold.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A series of looks passed between Gu..."
entries.dialogueText: A series of looks passed between Gus and Alphonso. They turned back to me.

entries.dialogueText: "No, sorry. I'd rather not bring more hard liquor into this country."

entries.dialogueText: "A shame, Your Majesty. But I do have one more proposal for you."

Ewald Alphonso (R)

entries.dialogueText: "Excellent, Your Majesty. And yes, there is one more proposal we wanted to discuss."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""As much as Sordland's most valued..."
entries.dialogueText: "As much as Sordland's most valued citizens would appreciate your wine, we believe there's something else they'd find even more stunning."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gestured at his surroundings, th..."
entries.dialogueText: He gestured at his surroundings, then down at the short-sleeved shirt he was wearing.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""Have you thought about Rizia's unt..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have you thought about Rizia's untapped tourism potential, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm afraid our conflicts with our..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid our conflicts with our neighbors would scare off visitors."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, many times. Our beaches put L..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, many times. Our beaches put Lespia's to shame, after all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We only want the right kind of tou..."
entries.dialogueText: "We only want the right kind of tourists, Mr. Manger. No riff-raff."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm listening...""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm listening..."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""I took the liberty of hiring a des..."
entries.dialogueText: "I took the liberty of hiring a designer to draw this up."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""None indeed.""
entries.dialogueText: "None indeed."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""Still, Your Majesty?""
entries.dialogueText: "Still, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""They're true diamonds in the rough.""
entries.dialogueText: "They're true diamonds in the rough."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He reached inside his jacket pocket..."
entries.dialogueText: He reached inside his jacket pocket and pulled out a sheet of paper with a sketch on it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I recognized the beach it depicted...."
entries.dialogueText: I recognized the beach it depicted. It was a picturesque stretch of sand in Monqiz, not far from the palace where I'd grown up.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Right on the coastline, the designe..."
entries.dialogueText: Right on the coastline, the designer had placed a sprawling complex with a swimming pool and tennis courts. On it was a sign: "Koronti Resort Valenqiris."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""House Toras would never stand for..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Toras would never stand for this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. I'm not bringing Sordish new m..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. I'm not bringing Sordish new money to Rizia."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""New money, old money -- it's all m..."
entries.dialogueText: "New money, old money -- it's all money. And the investors behind this proposal are itching to spend theirs here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's missing a private pier.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's missing a private pier."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Would that be the senior or the ju..."
entries.dialogueText: "Would that be the senior or the junior Koronti?"

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""It's only a rough sketch, Your Maj..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's only a rough sketch, Your Majesty. But yes, a private pier would go without saying."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""You are the head of House Toras, a..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are the head of House Toras, are you not?"

entries.speaker: Gus Manger (R)
entries.title: Gus Manger (R): ""You've done your research, I see...."
entries.dialogueText: "You've done your research, I see. This is Marcel's initiative. Along with certain other members of the Lotherberg Group."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alphonso swirled the last drops of..."
entries.dialogueText: Alphonso swirled the last drops of whiskey around in his glass.

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""I'm aware of how your nobles see S..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm aware of how your nobles see Sordish oligarchs. I'm also aware that their world-renowned riches have diminished with each successive generation."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso (R)
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso (R): ""Change is not merely inevitable, Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Change is not merely inevitable, Your Majesty -- it's the only way to preserve the lifestyle to which you're all so accustomed. Your grandmother understood that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lyza wouldn't have wanted a bunch..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lyza wouldn't have wanted a bunch of fat, sunburned vulgarians blocking her ocean views. No offense."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We don't need Sordland's help to s..."
entries.dialogueText: "We don't need Sordland's help to stay wealthy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am the king. The nobles would ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am the king. The nobles would have no choice but to acquiesce."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Well said, Mr. President. My relatives could use a good shock to the system."
